strings.name: Matei Zaharia
strings.summary: During his doctorate, Zaharia started Apache Spark, using memory-based computation to improve large-scale data processing. He later co-founded Databricks and helped develop MLflow and Delta Lake, connecting open-source systems with enterprise analytics and AI. He taught at MIT, Stanford and Berkeley, extending his research toward reliable AI systems and agents.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Starting Apache Spark
strings.highlights.h1.text: Created a distributed framework suited to iterative, large-scale analysis.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Open-source data tools
